at an average price of $80,846 U.S.

per token, representing more than 4% of BTC's circulating supply.
In recent days, Strategy repurchased nearly 2.1 million of its preferred stock (NASDAQ: $STRC) for about $208.2 million U.S., funded by its cash reserves.
In its most recent print, Strategy posted $19.5 billion U.S.

itens.descricao: Marvell Slides 3%, Lumentum Drops 6% on $115 Billion All-Stock Merger Deal; Coherent Climbs 2% Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Marvell's $115 billion all-stock acquisition of Lumentum implies $1,132 per share, yet Lumentum trades well below that, signaling deep market skepticism.
- Coherent surged 3% and NVIDIA holds a $2 billion stake in Lumentum, as the merger forces investors to reprice the entire optical connectivity sector.
Shares of Marvell trade at $190.43 in morning trading, down 3%.
Lumentum stock is at $788.51, down 6%, an unusual reaction for a takeover target.
Barron's reported on October 29 that the market disliked the idea of a Lumentum buyout, and Marvell stock fell 10% in the prior session as reports of the talks spread.
In that session, Lumentum stock dropped 9%.
Lumentum Trades Below Marvell's Implied Deal Value Marvell disclosed on November 2 the deal carries an enterprise value of $115 billion.
Under the terms, Lumentum stockholders would receive 4.5 Marvell shares for each share they own, a ratio Marvell said implies $1,132 per share and a 23.9% premium.

itens.titulo: Nvidia’s Fiscal 2028 Revenue Estimate Is Up 25% Since June. Here’s What November 17 Has to Prove
itens.descricao: Nvidia’s Fiscal 2028 Revenue Estimate Is Up 25% Since June. Here’s What November 17 Has to Prove Yahoo Finance
trechos: Key Stats for Nvidia Stock - Current Price: $204.64 - Target Price (Mid): ~$500 - Street Target: ~$329 - Potential Total Return: ~145% - Annualized IRR: ~23% / year What Happened?
Nvidia (NVDA:NASDAQ) fell 4.22% to $204.64 on October 30 as Intel's weak outlook and Amazon's results revived doubts about AI spending and dragged chip stocks lower.
Wall Street's revenue forecast for Nvidia's fiscal year ending January 2028 is up 25% since June 30, while the stock sits close to its $206.84 level at the end of the July quarter.

Separately, an October 30 notice listed Nvidia among 50 companies objecting to tokenized versions of their stock on ICE and OKX's planned 24/7 venue, a decision about where its shares trade, not what it earns.
The Price Stood Still In TIKR's consensus data, fiscal 2028 revenue rose from about $554 billion on June 30 to about $692 billion on November 2.
Coverage barely changed, from 55 analysts to 57, so that rise reflects revisions rather than new forecasters.
Fiscal 2029 rose 33%, to about $903 billion, though its coverage grew from 27 analysts to 38.
Most of both increases came in the quarter to September 30, after Nvidia's August 26 report, and both have edged up since even as chip stocks fell.

itens.titulo: Crypto Hack Losses Hit $8.74 in 2026, More Than Triple 2025, Yet Without Binance the Year Ran Quieter: How Did Bitcoin and Ethereum React After Major Hacks?
itens.descricao: Crypto Hack Losses Hit $8.74 in 2026, More Than Triple 2025, Yet Without Binance the Year Ran Quieter: How Did Bitcoin and Ethereum React After Major Hacks? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Crypto Hack Losses Hit $8.74 in 2026, More Than Triple 2025, Yet Without Binance the Year Ran Quieter: How Did Bitcoin and Ethereum React After Major Hacks?

Crypto hack losses reached $8.74 billion in 2026 by October 31, more than three times the $2.51 billion lost over the same ten months of 2025, after the October 29 Binance breach alone added $6.36 billion.
The rest of 2026 comes to $2.38 billion, about 5% less than 2025 at the same point, even though attackers hit 325 targets against 120 a year earlier.
Across the ten largest hacks since January 2025, Bitcoin's move on the day of the attack ranged from -4.1% to +1.9%.
A month later, for the nine with a full month of data, the range ran from -15.5% to +19.9%, and it followed whatever the broader market was doing.
The 2025 hacks landed in falling markets, and every one was followed by a lower Bitcoin price a month later.
Most of 2026's landed in rising ones.
So how bad has 2026 really been, and what does history say about the weeks after Binance?

itens.titulo: AMD Threatens False Breakout Ahead of Earnings
itens.descricao: AMD Threatens False Breakout Ahead of Earnings Yahoo Finance
trechos: In October of last year, OpenAI agreed to deploy up to six gigawatts of AMD Instinct accelerators, beginning with one gigawatt of MI450 silicon in the second half of 2026.

This past February, Meta signed a definitive multi-year agreement for up to six gigawatts of its own, built around a custom Instinct GPU based on the MI450 architecture, paired with sixth-generation EPYC processors and AMD's Helios rack-scale design.

AMD issued Meta a performance-based warrant for up to 160 million shares of its own stock, vesting in tranches as shipments scale toward six gigawatts and as AMD's share price clears defined thresholds.
Against roughly 1.85 billion shares outstanding, the Meta warrant alone represents potential dilution near 9%.
What the Numbers Say Heading In The Zacks Consensus Estimate for the September quarter stands at $1.94 per share, representing growth of 61.7% over the year-ago period.
Revenue is pegged at $13.12 billion, up 41.9%.
Company guidance called for roughly $13 billion give or take $300 million, with non-GAAP gross margin near 56%, so the Street and management are closely aligned.
